row_semantics: Each row represents a specific condition or action related to the ambient lamp control process.

column_semantics.Column 1: Condition Type (e.g., Precondition, Trigger Condition, Action, Exit Condition, Exception Handling)
column_semantics.Column 2: Description of the condition, trigger, action, exit criteria, or exception handling

core_entities.name: Ambient Lamp
core_entities.description: The lighting feature that provides illumination around the vehicle's interior.

core_entities.name: DoorFL1LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Local control signal for brightness adjustment of the front left ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFL1LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Local control signal to turn the front left ambient lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: DoorFL1LampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Signal to set the fade speed when turning the ambient lamp on or off.

core_entities.name: ZCU
core_entities.description: Zone Control Unit, responsible for managing various vehicle functions including lighting.

core_entities.name: LIN Signal
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network signal used for communication between the ZCU and other modules.

core_conditions.name: Precondition
core_conditions.description: Ambient lamp is in the closed state.

core_conditions.name: Trigger Condition
core_conditions.description: Receiving a local brightness change request signal DoorFL1LampBrtnsCmd_1 from the ambient lamp local control module.

core_conditions.name: Exit Condition
core_conditions.description: Conditions under which the system exits the current control logic, such as receiving a no request signal, an off command, or a brightness value within a reserved range.

core_outputs.name: PWM Signal
core_outputs.description: Pulse Width Modulation signal generated by the ambient lamp drive control module to adjust the lamp's brightness.

core_outputs.name: Lamp State
core_outputs.description: The current on/off state and brightness level of the ambient lamp.

core_faults.name: Overvoltage/Undervoltage Fault
core_faults.description: If the ambient lamp module experiences overvoltage or undervoltage, the lamp is directly turned off.

core_faults.name: LIN Communication Timeout
core_faults.description: If the ZCU's LIN signal is not received within a certain time (default 6 seconds), the ambient lamp is directly turned off.

core_faults.name: Brightness Value Abnormality
core_faults.description: If the brightness value DoorFL1LampBrtnsCmd_1 is abnormal, the lamp maintains the previous state.

core_timing_constraints.name: LIN Signal Timeout
core_timing_constraints.description: The system will turn off the ambient lamp if the ZCU's LIN signal is not received within 6 seconds.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the logic for controlling the brightness and on/off state of the front left ambient lamp based on local control signals. It specifies the conditions under which the lamp is activated, adjusted, or deactivated, as well as the fault handling procedures to ensure safe operation.
uncertain_points: The exact behavior when DoorFL1LampBrtnsCmd_1 is within the reserved range (0x65-0xFF) is not fully defined and may require further clarification.
